title: LOCAL_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME tracking (1200s)
notes: Implemented a non-dead, publicly exported Python local-evidence tracker on clean paths. LOCAL_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_SECONDS is exactly 1200; callers refresh authenticated announce/rrep/rpl/data observations and cannot inject expiry. Tracker uses a monotonic u64 time domain, rejects regressions/expiry overflow atomically, expires at equality, refreshes for a full new lifetime, defaults to a bounded 32-peer table, refuses silent live eviction, and reuses expired slots. Added normative spec text plus dedicated closed schema and deterministic 7-scenario operation vectors. Green: 18 focused pytest, ruff, mypy, JSON/schema validation, git diff check; read-only cargo check -p lichen-core --no-default-features. Rust lib/loadng files were concurrently dirty and untouched, as were Python routing/dodag/loadng. No codereview/commit/push.
